info.text:
Amber on cream looks fine. It measures 2.9 to 1, and that fails.
https://ka-performancefl.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-09-29-5

Body text needs 4.5 to 1. Same palette, rust instead: 6.7 to 1, passes. Amber still works on buttons with dark text on top. Measure every color you set text in; your eye is a bad checker.

Every site K&A Performance builds passes these checks. Every ratio in the video is computed from the real hex values.

The music is AI generated.
